interactions.assay: radio immuno assay (RIA) · dissociation constant KD
interactions.note: The equilibrium dissociation constant of epitope-specific [I125]-labeled antibody Apomab binding to a DR5-Fc fusion protein was determined using saturation analysis. The binding constant was in agreement with that obtained by competitive binding analysis (IC50 = 1.4 nM). Apomab bound to the extracellular domain of DR5, but did not bind to other human Apo2L/TRAIL receptors (DR4, decoy receptor 1, DcR2 and OPG).

interactions.target_raw: Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 10B
interactions.note: The epitope-specific antibody Apomab displayed proapototic activity, as demonstrated by a dose-dependent loss of viability in COLO205 colorectal cancer cells and H2122 non-small cell lung cancer cells. Apomab also induced a DR5-associated death-inducing signaling complex (DISC) with recruitment of FADD and caspase-8.

interactions.target_raw: Tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 10B
interactions.note: The epitope recognized by Fab-YSd1 on hDR5 extracellular domain was determined by X-ray diffraction and solved by molecular replacement analysis. Despite the modest resolution of the structure, the electron density maps are of high quality and allow for accurate determination of backbone and side chain positions. There are two Fab-antigen complexes in the asymmetric unit. Fab binds to the N-terminal portion of hDR5 and occludes the smaller of two binding sites for the natural hDR5 ligand Apo2L/TRAIL.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.35 angstroms

interactions.note: The epitope of AMG 655 Fab on the Death receptor 5 (DR 5) in complex with Apo2L/TRAIL was determined from the crystal structure of the ternary complex. The Apo2L/TRAIL-DR5-AMG 655-Fab complex is composed of an Apo2L/TRAIL homotrimer with three DR5 monomers bound diagonally along the crevices between two neighboring Apo2L/TRAIL molecules and three AMG 655 Fabs bound to the three DR5 monomers individually.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 3.3 angstroms

interactions.note: Addition of the epitope-specific AMG 655 mAb plus protein G (which provides maximal crosslinking of DR 5) or Apo2L/TRAIL induced dose-dependent loss of viability in WM35 melanoma cells and other cancer cell lines. AMG 655 in the absence of protein G had no effect. Unexpectedly, pretreatment with AMG 655 (in the absence of protein G) markedly enhanced killing induced by Apo2L/TRAIL.
